faqs.question: What is the minimum order quantity (MOQ) and unit price for Custom Full-Color Offset Epoxy-Dome Metal Fridge Magnets?

faqs.question: What is the mold or tooling fee for Custom Full-Color Offset Epoxy-Dome Metal Fridge Magnets, and when is it waived?

faqs.question: What base materials and manufacturing crafts are used on Custom Full-Color Offset Epoxy-Dome Metal Fridge Magnets?

faqs.answer: Yes. Send your vector logo (.AI, .EPS, .SVG, or vector .PDF) or rough sketch via our quote form or WhatsApp, and our engineering team will send a free 1:1 scaled digital production proof within 12 hours.

faqs.answer: Yes. Pre-production physical samples take 7–10 business days (paid sample covers custom mold cutting to your design, plating, and enamel finishing; courier air freight is billed at carrier cost or via your DHL/FedEx account).

faqs.question: What is the bulk production lead time for Custom Full-Color Offset Epoxy-Dome Metal Fridge Magnets?
faqs.answer: Mass production for Custom Full-Color Offset Epoxy-Dome Metal Fridge Magnets completes in 7–10 Days after digital artwork proof or physical sample approval, followed by multi-point pre-shipment inspection for color accuracy, plating luster, and attachment security.

faqs.question: Does Custom Full-Color Offset Epoxy-Dome Metal Fridge Magnets meet US CPSIA, California Prop 65, and EU REACH safety standards?
